newsitem.title: USA: GoodMark sees Q3 sales, EPS below 1995 Q3.
newsitem.headline: GoodMark sees Q3 sales, EPS below 1995 Q3.

text.p: GoodMark Foods Inc said Tuesday it expects its third quarter sales and earnings to be below expectations and below the prior year's third quarter.
The company's third quarter ends February 23.

In the prior year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $1.6 million, or $0.20 per share, on sales of $42.74 million. This year's third quarter results are expected to be released March 18.
GoodMark, the maker of Slim Jims, said in a statement that its third quarter branded snack sales will be "well below" earlier expecations and "slightly below" the prior year's period.
According to First Call, the analysts' mean estimate for the third quarter is $0.34 per share.
